checkpoint: **Checkpoint, 22 Nov 2026, end of the second pass.** Everything listed as changed is built, tested and on the Game Review page. To carry on: (1) read this file, `specs/audit-2026-11-22.md` ("Still to do") and the top of `LESSONS.md`; (2) the tools for looking are not in the repo (they lived in `/tmp/audit`): a sheet of pictures per game (the game's robot plays level 1's first seconds, then level 5 at 3, 10 and 20 s, with `window.__fullGL = true`), honest-robot win rates through `bots.js`, and a "win at an odd moment" sweep (start, call `__sim.winNow()` at 0 to 9 s, the result card must come with no page error: this is what found Splash Course's crash); rebuild them when needed; (3) next games, worst first: Sumo (three buttons), Tennis (the swipe's speed secretly picks the shot), Gridiron (receivers), Dress Designer (model), Short Order (camera), Shadow Crew (slow), then the "reviewing" entries below whose "Still open" names a gesture; (4) the long `test_play.py` for Eleven, Ice Hockey and Hoops (over 25 minutes each) has not been run to the end since their team-mates changed; (5) after any change to `tools/juice-kit.js` or `tools/world3d.js`, rebuild all 103 games, load them all, and re-run every `test_touch.py`, then `tools/test_controls.py` with no arguments, alone; (6) nothing here goes on the app: `in_app` is his word only.
shared: tools/world3d.js: a fill light from behind the player's eye; brighter night, dusk, rain and storm; thinner fog. Affects all 82 3D games. Regression: every game loads; robot play of all 103 showed no errors; pictures of 20 dark-level games looked at before and after.

tools/juice-kit.js: the band (music) for 100 games; a Settings card added where missing. Its room echo was first a convolution reverb: two touch tests (Tennis, Ice Hockey) then failed on timing, so it is now two cheap feedback echoes; both pass again. Regression: every game's own touch test re-run (104 have one; all pass, three needed a second run under load: Powder, Drift Kings, Kart Kingdom), tools/test_controls.py for all 111, tools/check.py.
Kart Kingdom's own `music` renamed `trackMusic` (it clashed with the kit).

Regression at the end of the second pass (22 Nov, build 720f575): `tools/check.py` all 111 games pass; `tools/test_controls.py` for all 111 in one run, 3540 checks pass; `tools/win_sweep.py` (a win in the first instant and a moment later) all 103 games from 9 on: the result card comes, nothing throws; each changed game's `test_touch.py` and `test_play.py` pass (the three team games' long test_play excepted).

Splash Course's empty-ghost crash was the reason GitHub's checks failed on both earlier pushes of 22 Nov (nothing was published in between; the app's eight games were not affected). `tools/test_controls.py` now goes on to the next game when one game's test falls over, and prints that game's page errors.
GitHub's own checks passed on that build (run 45038106717, 22 Nov): the first green run since Santa's Round.
